clauses.title: Purchase Orders and Lead Times
clauses.verbatim_text: Supplier shall manufacture and deliver precision sensor assemblies pursuant to Buyer purchase orders with a guaranteed production lead time of forty-five (45) business days.
obligations: Supplier must manufacture and deliver precision sensor assemblies
Supplier must adhere to 45 business days guaranteed production lead time
rights: Buyer receives manufactured sensor assemblies within 45 business days of PO
conditions: Triggered upon Buyer issuing purchase orders
material_claims: Supplier manufactures and delivers precision sensor assemblies pursuant to Buyer purchase orders
Guaranteed production lead time is forty-five (45) business days

clauses.title: Price Adjustments and Currency
clauses.verbatim_text: Unit component prices remain fixed for initial twelve months. Annual price increases shall not exceed five percent (5.0%) and require sixty (60) days advance documented cost justification.
obligations: Supplier must keep unit component prices fixed for initial 12 months
Supplier must cap annual price increases at 5.0% and provide 60 days advance documented cost justification
rights: Buyer is protected by fixed prices for 12 months and 5% cap on annual increases
conditions: Price increases allowed only after initial 12 months and require 60 days advance documented cost justification
material_claims: Unit component prices fixed for initial 12 months
Requires 60 days advance documented cost justification

clauses.title: Product Warranty and Defect Remedies
clauses.verbatim_text: Supplier warrants that all delivered components are free from manufacturing defects for twenty-four (24) months from delivery date. Supplier shall repair or replace non-conforming parts within fourteen (14) calendar days.
obligations: Supplier warrants components free from defects for 24 months from delivery
Supplier must repair or replace non-conforming parts within 14 calendar days
rights: Buyer receives 24-month defect warranty and 14-day replacement/repair remedy
conditions: Warranty period is 24 months from delivery date
material_claims: 24-month manufacturing defect warranty from delivery date
Supplier must repair or replace defective parts within 14 calendar days

clauses.title: Patent Infringement and Product Indemnification
clauses.verbatim_text: Supplier agrees to defend and indemnify Buyer, its affiliates, and customers from and against any third-party claims alleging patent infringement or personal injury arising from component manufacturing defects.
obligations: Supplier must defend and indemnify Buyer, affiliates, and customers against third-party patent infringement and personal injury claims
rights: Buyer, affiliates, and customers receive full indemnity and defense from Supplier
conditions: Applies to claims alleging patent infringement or personal injury arising from component manufacturing defects
material_claims: Supplier must defend and indemnify Buyer, affiliates, and customers
Covers third-party patent infringement claims and personal injury claims from manufacturing defects

clauses.title: Agreement Term and Termination Rights
clauses.verbatim_text: Either party may terminate this agreement without cause upon ninety (90) days prior written notice. Either party may terminate immediately without notice upon the insolvency or bankruptcy of the other party.
obligations: Party terminating without cause must give 90 days prior written notice
rights: Either party may terminate without cause on 90 days notice
Either party may terminate immediately without notice upon insolvency or bankruptcy of the other
conditions: Immediate termination permitted upon insolvency or bankruptcy
exceptions: Notice requirement waived for insolvency or bankruptcy
material_claims: Termination without cause on 90 days prior written notice
Immediate termination without notice upon insolvency or bankruptcy

clauses.title: Applicable Law and Judicial Jurisdiction
clauses.verbatim_text: This Agreement shall be interpreted and governed in all respects in accordance with the substantive laws of England and Wales, with exclusive jurisdiction in the High Court of Justice in London.
obligations: Submit to exclusive jurisdiction of High Court of Justice in London
material_claims: Governed by substantive laws of England and Wales
Exclusive jurisdiction in the High Court of Justice in London
